concerns.text: The 'Verified Datasets' block lists only generic NCBI, GEO, and unrelated parquet resources (e.g., https://huggingface.co/datasets/pie/ncbi_disease/... and https://huggingface.co/datasets/heig-vd-geo/GridNet-HD/...), none of which provide the required paired proteomic + transcriptomic data for Arabidopsis, rice, or wheat under drought, salinity, or heat stresses. This means the plan relies on datasets that are inappropriate for the core research question, violating FR‑001 and rendering the scientific outcome unattainable. The pipeline’s fallback to a “dummy” dataset does not satisfy the requirement to answer the hypothesis.
